All of its kind have the same stats, so breeding doesn't give better ones. Once tamed, it doesn't wander far from where you dismount it.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is very long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.minecraft.mooshroom.descripti:
Lives in Mushroom Fields. It can only be milked or stewed once in a while.

Search #mooshroom_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.minecraft.mule.description:
Born when a tamed Horse and a tamed Donkey fall in love near each other. Like the Donkey it can carry a Chest, and it swims with you on its back.

Search #mule_food in EMI to see what it eats.

All of its kind have the same stats, so breeding doesn't give better ones. Once tamed, it doesn't wander far from where you dismount it.
fieldguide.minecraft.ocelot.description:
Lives in Jungles. Taming one turns it into a Cat. It slowly heals over time.

Search #ocelot_food in EMI to see what it eats.

Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.
fieldguide.minecraft.panda.description:
Lives in Jungles and Bamboo Jungles.

Search #panda_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.
fieldguide.minecraft.parrot.description:
Lives in Jungles and comes in many colors. Tamed with its food; when two fall in love, one lays a Parrot Egg. It stays on your shoulder while you fly and through short falls: crouch to let it down. With a Parrot on each shoulder and a tamed Bird on your head, you can fly slowly. It slowly heals over time.

Search #parrot_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is very long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.minecraft.pig.description:
Lives in plains, taigas, jungles and Cherry Groves, but not in forests, savannas or swamps.

Search #pig_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

It grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.minecraft.polar_bear.descript: Lives in Snowy Plains, Ice Spikes and frozen oceans.
fieldguide.minecraft.pufferfish.descript: Lives in warm and lukewarm oceans. Comes in random sizes.
fieldguide.minecraft.rabbit.description:
Lives in Deserts, snowy biomes, taigas, many forests, Meadows and Cherry Groves. Falls barely hurt it.

Search #rabbit_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.minecraft.salmon.description: Lives in rivers and cold oceans. Comes in random sizes.
fieldguide.minecraft.sheep.description:
Lives in most grassy biomes, but not in savannas or swamps. Its wool grows back, and grown-up and old Sheep give more wool.

Search #sheep_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.minecraft.skeleton_horse.desc:
Never found alone: lightning during a thunderstorm can be a trap that spawns four Skeleton Horsemen. The fastest mount, and it swims with you on its back.

All of its kind have the same stats, so breeding doesn't give better ones. Once tamed, it doesn't wander far from where you dismount it.
fieldguide.minecraft.sniffer.description:
Only hatches from Sniffer Eggs, found by brushing Suspicious Sand in Warm Ocean Ruins and Jungle Temples.

Search #sniffer_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.
fieldguide.minecraft.snow_golem.descript: Build one with two Snow Blocks and a Carved Pumpkin. Its snowballs deal damage and freeze what they hit. It climbs ladders and is healed by snowballs. Name it after a player: if a Witch kills it, it drops that player's head.
fieldguide.minecraft.squid.description: Lives in rivers and oceans. Comes in random sizes.
fieldguide.minecraft.tadpole.description: Hatches from the Frogspawn that Frogs lay in water.
fieldguide.minecraft.trader_llama.descri:
Comes with the Wandering Trader. Some carry more than others.

Search #trader_llama_food in EMI to see what it eats.

All of its kind have the same stats, so breeding doesn't give better ones. Once tamed, it doesn't wander far from where you dismount it.

Its life is very long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.minecraft.tropical_fish.descr: Lives in warm oceans, Lush Caves and Mangrove Swamps. Comes in random sizes.
fieldguide.minecraft.turtle.description:
Lives on Beaches. Its Scutes drop as a block you can place and stack.

Search #turtle_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.
fieldguide.minecraft.villager.descriptio:
Villages are abandoned: Villagers only come from curing Zombie Villagers, apart from a few prisoners in Strongholds, Woodland Mansions and Igloos. They can't breed.

They only sell, each trade for one Emerald. Prices go up with use and don't come back down, stock is restocked once a day and they keep their trades if they lose their job site. They follow you while you hold an Emerald.

They eat to heal, call Iron Golems now and then, more often when in danger, and smiths repair Iron Golems. They only fight back against players they really dislike.
fieldguide.minecraft.wandering_trader.de: Shows up near players now and then, with Trader Llamas. Sells plants, seeds and explorer maps, abandoned villages included, for one Emerald each, and buys a few items, like Music Discs, Hay Bales and Milk Buckets, for one Emerald.
fieldguide.minecraft.wolf.description:
Lives in forests, taigas and groves. Wolves slowly heal over time, and tamed ones run to catch up with you. Pet one by crouching and right-clicking with an empty hand. Wolves left sitting for a while lie down. Wild Wolves hunt Deer and Moles, and dig Moles out of the ground.

Search #wolf_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is very long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.minecraft.zombie_horse.descri:
Roams Plains, Snowy Plains and Savannas at night and in their caves, but it's rare. It comes with a Zombie riding it and burns in sunlight unless it wears Horse Armor, which wears out instead. Without its rider it can be tamed and ridden, but it can't breed. One under Weakness fed a Golden Carrot slowly turns into a Horse. Tougher but slower than a Horse; it swims with you on its back.

Search #zombie_horse_food in EMI to see what it eats.

All of its kind have the same stats, so breeding doesn't give better ones. Once tamed, it doesn't wander far from where you dismount it.
fieldguide.naturalist.alligator.descript:
Lives in Swamps, Mangrove Swamps and along Rivers, and breathes underwater. It attacks players in the water, at night and near its eggs, and hunts Deer, Ducks, Snakes, Catfish and Frogs. It lays Alligator Eggs.

Search #alligator_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.anglerfish.descrip: Lives deep in all oceans except frozen ones, in the dark; the deepest ones glow. It hunts Cod and Tropical Fish and bites back when hit. Comes in random sizes, and can be caught in a Bucket.
fieldguide.naturalist.ant.description: Lives in Ant Hills in Jungles and Savannas. Ants carry food they find on the ground back to their hill, get angry if you take it, and the whole colony attacks whoever hurts one of them. Sugar heals them. Plant a Queen Ant to start your own hill, whose Ants defend you.
fieldguide.naturalist.bass.description: Lives in Rivers, Swamps and Mangrove Swamps, in schools of the same size. Bigger Bass are rarer, eat smaller ones and sometimes grow even bigger. Comes in random sizes, and can be caught in a Bucket.
fieldguide.naturalist.bear.description:
Lives in forests, taigas and Groves. It sleeps at midday and after midnight, and attacks players at night, in the dark and near its cubs. It raids Beehives, Sweet Berry Bushes and Campfires and picks up food from the ground: dropping some can calm a chasing Bear.

A cub fed its food can be tamed. Shear an adult for Fur, best while it sleeps.

Search #bear_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.bird.description:
Lives in almost every land biome, and its species depends on where it lives. It flees from you unless you crouch. Throw its food on the ground to tame it: a tamed Bird sits on your head and slows your falls, and with a Parrot on each shoulder too you can fly slowly. Crouch to let it down.

Search #bird_food in EMI to see what it eats.
fieldguide.naturalist.black_bear.descrip:
Lives in forests, taigas and Groves. It sleeps at midday and after midnight, and attacks players at night, in the dark and near its cubs. It raids Beehives, Sweet Berry Bushes and Campfires and picks up food from the ground: dropping some can calm a chasing Bear.

A cub fed its food can be tamed. Shear an adult for Fur, best while it sleeps.

Search #black_bear_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.blobfish.descripti: Lives deep in all oceans except frozen ones, near the sea floor. Brought close to the surface it turns into a shapeless blob, and gets its shape back in the deep. It hunts Crabs and Snails. Comes in random sizes, and can be caught in a Bucket.
fieldguide.naturalist.boar.description:
Lives in forests and Savannas, in small groups. It fights back when hit.

Search #boar_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

It grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.butterfly.descript:
Lives in forests, Plains and Swamps. It collects nectar from flowers and helps nearby crops grow. Butterflies that fall in love lay a Caterpillar instead of having a baby.

Search #butterfly_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is very short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.capybara.descripti:
Lives in Jungles, Swamps and Mangrove Swamps. Completely peaceful, it sleeps through the day, swims well and takes no fall damage. Its food can tame it.

Search #capybara_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

It grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.caterpillar.descri: Born from Butterflies. It climbs the side of a log and turns into a Chrysalis, which hatches into a Butterfly.
fieldguide.naturalist.catfish.descriptio: Lives in Swamps and Mangrove Swamps. It hunts small fish and Tadpoles and swallows Bass whole. Comes in random sizes, and can be caught in a Bucket.
fieldguide.naturalist.clam.description: Lives on the floor of all oceans except frozen ones. Some hold a treasure and snap shut when you come close, unless you crouch: take it while the Clam is open. It's almost unhurtable while closed, and opening under your feet it throws you up.
fieldguide.naturalist.crab.description:
Lives on Beaches and Stony Shores. It hides in its shell when you come close, unless you crouch or hold its food, which can tame it. It picks up swords and tools from the ground and fights with them. Tamed Crabs dance to Jukeboxes.

Search #naturalist:crab_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.deer.description:
Lives in forests, Groves and Cherry Groves. It grazes, runs from players unless they crouch, and from Bears, Tigers, Alligators and Wolves. Its Antlers brew into a potion.

Search #deer_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

It grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.desert_scorpion.de: Lives in Deserts and Badlands. Its sting poisons, and it attacks players in the dark, like Spiders. It hunts Lizards, and Lizard Tails heal it. Caught with a Capture Net and released, it stops attacking players.
fieldguide.naturalist.dragonfly.descript: Lives in Swamps and Mangrove Swamps. A Frog that eats one drops Froglass of its color. Feed it Chorus Fruit and it breathes a small harmful cloud.
fieldguide.naturalist.duck.description:
Lives in Rivers, Swamps and Mangrove Swamps, and swims as much as it walks. Its food can tame a duckling, and it lays Duck Eggs. A duckling can be scooped up with a Bucket.

Search #duck_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.elephant.descripti:
Lives in Savannas. It gets angry when hit or when its calves are, and its food heals it. Feed a calf Cake a few times to tame it: once grown it can be saddled, ridden and given a Chest.

Search #elephant_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is very long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.firefly.descriptio: Comes out at night in forests, Plains, Swamps, Mushroom Fields and the Glimmering Weald. It flashes in the dark, vanishes in sunlight and drops Glow Goop.
fieldguide.naturalist.giant_isopod.descr:
Lives on the floor of all oceans except frozen ones. It curls up when you come close, taking less damage. It can be caught in a Bucket.

Search #giant_isopod_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.giraffe.descriptio:
Lives in Savannas and never attacks. Its food can tame a calf: once grown, ride it with an empty hand, no Saddle needed.

Search #giraffe_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
Lives in Warm and Lukewarm oceans. It hunts fish, and attacks players swimming in the dark, charging and circling back between strikes. Its food heals it, but it can't be tamed.

Search #great_white_shark_food in EMI to see what it eats.
fieldguide.naturalist.hedgehog.descripti:
Lives in forests, Plains, Meadows and taigas. It rolls into a ball when you come close, unless you crouch or hold its food, hurting whatever touches it. It ignores fall damage, Cactus and Sweet Berry Bushes. Its food can tame it.

Search #hedgehog_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.hippo.description:
Lives in Savannas and Jungles. It attacks players in the water, follows them onto land and attacks boats. A calf is tamed with its food, and a tamed Hippo leaves you alone in the water.

Search #hippo_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.jellyfish.descript: Drifts in all oceans except frozen ones, stinging whatever touches it. Comes in random sizes, and can be caught in a Bucket.
fieldguide.naturalist.jungle_scorpion.de: Lives in Jungles. Bigger than the Desert Scorpion, its sting poisons, and it attacks players in the dark, like Spiders. It hunts Lizards, and Lizard Tails heal it.
fieldguide.naturalist.komodo_dragon.desc:
Lives in Deserts, Badlands, Savannas and Jungles. It basks in the sun, hunts small animals, and turns on players who stay near it for a while. Its bite poisons. It can't be tamed.

Search #komodo_dragon_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.lion.description:
Lives in Savannas, in prides led by a maneless Lion. It sleeps by day, hunts Zebras, Rhinos, Boars and Horses at night, and defends its cubs. A cub fed its food can be tamed.

Search #lion_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.lizard.description:
Lives in Deserts, Savannas, Jungles, Swamps and forests. When badly hurt it drops its tail to escape, and grows it back later. Its food tames it, and tamed Lizards get tougher. It can't be bred.

Search #lizard_food in EMI to see what it eats.
fieldguide.naturalist.mammoth.descriptio:
Lives in Snowy Plains, Ice Spikes, Snowy Slopes and Frozen Peaks, in herds. Its hits throw you into the air, and it avoids Bees. Feed a calf Cake a few times to tame it: once grown it can be saddled, ridden and given a Chest.

Search #mammoth_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is very long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.mole.description: Lives in forests, Plains and Meadows. It burrows when it spots undead, sprinting players or whoever hurt it, and can't be hurt underground except when it peeks out. Fire, water and Wolves force it out. It can't be tamed or bred.
fieldguide.naturalist.ostrich.descriptio:
Lives in Savannas. It buries its head when you come close, unless you crouch or hold its food, which tames a chick at once. Once grown it can be saddled, ridden and made to jump, and falls slowly. It lays eggs on Sand or Dirt and attacks anyone who comes near them; Zombies trample them.

Search #ostrich_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas.

It grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.piranha.descriptio: Lives in Jungle waters and Lush Caves, in big schools that follow their leader and attack players in the water. Hit one and the whole school comes for you. Comes in random sizes, and can be caught in a Bucket.
fieldguide.naturalist.rat.description:
Lives in forests, Plains and Groves, and climbs walls. Its food tames it easily. Release a tamed Rat from a Capture Net onto a Chest and it harvests and replants the ripe crops around it, storing them inside.

Search #rat_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.ray.description: Glides near the floor of all oceans except frozen ones. Hit it and its sting poisons you. Comes in random sizes, and can be caught in a Bucket.
fieldguide.naturalist.rhino.description: Lives in Savannas, in small groups. Adults charge at players near their young. It can't be tamed or bred.
fieldguide.naturalist.snail.description:
Lives in most temperate biomes and in caves. It climbs walls, hides in its shell when you come close, taking less damage, and now and then makes Slime Balls. It lays Snail Eggs and can be dyed.

Search #snail_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.snake.description:
Lives in forests, plains, Jungles, Swamps, Rivers, Beaches and dry biomes: Coral Snakes and Rattlesnakes in warm ones, green Snakes elsewhere. It hunts small animals; Coral Snakes and Rattlesnakes poison, and Rattlesnakes rattle when you come close. Some of its food tames it.

Search #snake_food in EMI to see what it eats.
fieldguide.naturalist.starfish.descripti: Lives on the floor of all oceans except frozen ones. It drops itself as a block you can place, and can be caught in a Bucket.
fieldguide.naturalist.tiger.description:
Lives alone in Jungles, Dark Forests, Cherry Groves, mountains, snowy slopes, Badlands, Deserts and Swamps, as a Tiger, White Tiger, Leopard or Black Panther depending on the biome. It sleeps by day, stalks Boars, Pigs, Deer, Zebras and Snakes at night and fights back when hit. A cub fed its food can be tamed.

Search #tiger_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.tortoise.descripti:
Lives in Deserts, Jungles and Swamps. It hides in its shell when you come close, unless you crouch or hold its food, taking less damage and barely knocked back. Its food can tame it, and it lays Tortoise Eggs. Tamed Tortoises get tougher.

Search #tortoise_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas.

Its life is long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.turkey.description:
Lives in forests, taigas and Groves. It runs from players unless they crouch or hold its food, and chases Ants. It falls slowly and takes no fall damage.

Search #turkey_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.naturalist.vulture.descriptio: Flies high over Deserts, Badlands and Savannas and perches on Cacti. It attacks Zombies and dives at players low on health who hold something.
fieldguide.naturalist.whale.description:
Lives in all oceans except frozen ones, surfacing for air before diving back down. Jellyfish and Pufferfish can't sting it.

Search #whale_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.
fieldguide.naturalist.zebra.description:
Lives in Savannas, in herds, and runs from players. Tame it by riding it until it stops throwing you off; then it can be saddled and given a Chest.

Search #zebra_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is very long, but it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.ecologics.coconut_crab.descri:
Comes out of some of the Coconuts that smash when falling from Coconut trees on Beaches. With a Coconut on its back it takes less damage and fights back when hit; badly hurt, the shell breaks into Coconut Slices and it runs from players instead. Give it a Coconut to put a new one on its back. It takes no fall damage.

Search #coconut_crab_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.ecologics.penguin.description:
Lives in groups in Frozen Oceans, Frozen Rivers and Snowy Plains. It swims fast, holds its breath for a long time, slides on ice, hunts fish and picks up fish from the ground to eat. Standing near a big group of Penguins gives you Regeneration. After mating, a Penguin gives birth some time later, and a chick drops a Penguin Feather when it grows up.

Search #penguin_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas.

It grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
fieldguide.ecologics.squirrel.descriptio:
Lives in Plains and climbs walls and trees. It runs from Foxes. Walnuts make it follow you and can win its trust: a trusting Squirrel picks up Saplings and plants them.

Search #squirrel_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.

Its life is short: it grows old and dies of old age. Feeding it a Poisonous Potato stops its aging.
Sometimes comes when the Wandering Trader doesn't, more often in places you've spent a long time in, on harder difficulties and once the Ender Dragon is dead. Evokers can also turn a Wandering Trader into one. It sells explosives, Cannons and Rope, throws Bombs at Zombies and raiders, and leaves after a while.
fieldguide.supplementaries.plunderer.des: Comes with raids on villages near water, steering the Pillagers' boats in from the sea. It fights with a Golden Sword, fires Cannons it finds nearby, sometimes carries a Parrot on its shoulder and slowly heals over time.
fieldguide.minecraft.camel_husk.descript:
Some of the Husks in Deserts ride one, with a Parched behind them. Once its riders are gone it can be saddled and ridden like a Camel, but it can't be bred. It despawns like a monster until you interact with it.

Search #camel_husk_food in EMI to see what it eats.
fieldguide.minecraft.copper_golem.descri:
Build one by placing a Carved Pumpkin on a Block of Copper. It takes items from Copper Chests and puts them in nearby chests that already hold the same item, or in empty ones. Use it with an empty hand to take what it's carrying.

It oxidizes over time, and once fully oxidized it can turn into a statue. Scrape it with an Axe to remove the oxidation, or wax it with a Honeycomb to stop it; lightning also removes some.
fieldguide.minecraft.creaking.descriptio: Comes out of a Creaking Heart in the Pale Garden at night, and vanishes at sunrise. It only moves when no one is looking at it and can't be killed by attacking it: every hit makes Resin Clumps grow around its heart. Break the Creaking Heart to destroy it.
fieldguide.minecraft.happy_ghast.descrip:
Hatches as a Ghastling from a Dried Ghast left in water. Ghastlings stay close to players, and feeding them makes them grow up faster.

Put a Harness on an adult to ride it with up to three friends: the first player steers, and it holds still while someone stands on top of it. It heals slowly, faster in the rain or in the clouds, and Speed and Slowness change how fast it flies. It can't be bred.

Search #happy_ghast_food in EMI to see what it eats.
fieldguide.minecraft.nautilus.descriptio:
Lives in oceans, more often in temperate and warm ones than in cold ones. It hunts Pufferfish, charges at whoever hurts it and can't be poisoned. Pufferfish can tame it: a tamed Nautilus can be saddled and ridden underwater, wears armor, gives its rider Breath of the Nautilus and dashes forward on command. Wild ones despawn until you interact with them.

Search #nautilus_food in EMI to see what it eats.

It can't be bred by hand: adults fall in love on their own now and then, much more often for a while after you feed them, and less in crowded areas. Breeding can fail and sometimes gives twins.
fieldguide.minecraft.parched.description:
Lives in Deserts, and some ride a Camel Husk behind a Husk. It doesn't burn in sunlight, and its arrows give Weakness.

Skeletons shoot from a long range and back away if you get close, but aren't very accurate. They wear armor more often under a full moon and deep underground, and they come in different sizes. They climb ladders, some ride other mobs and leaders call others to help.
fieldguide.minecraft.sulfur_cube.descrip:
Lives in Sulfur Caves and never attacks. Use a block on an adult to make it swallow it: it stops wandering, can be pushed around and leashed, and the block changes how it moves and bounces. Wood makes it bouncy, ice makes it slide, Wool makes it light, Honeycomb Blocks make it sticky and Magma Blocks make it hurt on touch.

One holding TNT explodes when lit with Flint and Steel, set on fire or powered by redstone. Shear it to get the block back, or catch it in a Bucket. When killed it splits into two babies, and a baby fed its food grows up faster.

Search #sulfur_cube_food in EMI to see what it eats.
fieldguide.minecraft.zombie_nautilus.des:
In oceans, half of the Drowned ride one; in warm oceans it's covered in coral. It burns in sunlight unless it wears armor, which wears out instead. Without a rider it can be tamed with Pufferfish, then saddled and ridden underwater like a Nautilus, but it can't be bred.

Search #nautilus_food in EMI to see what it eats.
